flags.message: The snapshot's LowerCourt field reads 'United States Bankruptcy Appellate Panel for the 10th Circuit' with case number 26-2404, but the staged application's own cover says it arises from the United States Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit (No. 26-2404), and it was submitted to the Chief Justice. The lower-court label looks wrong upstream. It did not change any score.

All three candidates report that the application text they were given was empty (documents.json empty_text true, fetched Nov 6), while the copy staged for the evaluator (fetched 2026-11-11) carries OCR text. The predictors therefore forecast without the application's content. I did not penalize them for it.
